== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Fleet Security Protocols (Errata 2)]] (<code>1261_34</code>), showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-34-Fleet_Security_Protocols.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-fleetsecurityprotocols-pre.gif]]) both show the PC-E1 text of [[Fleet Security Protocols (Errata)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may deploy a non-unique starship (or vehicle) site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle where you have a starship or vehicle, characters at related starship (or vehicle) sites cumulatively add 2 to your total power and may be forfeited to reduce battle damage or attrition. When a starship (or vehicle) site leaves table, place it and all cards there in owner's Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number, copyright line) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-34-Fleet_Security_Protocols-PC-E2-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B09 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
